tasks.title: Expose debugger requests, snapshots and progress
tasks.goal: Use the shared service protocol for structured debugger input and output.
steps: Register inspect/tree/explain/cost/compare/capture/cancel models on M-16 context/overlay/event contracts.
Generate and validate request/result/error/progress schemas; expose structured CLI input and MCP adapters.
Bind pages/filters/chunks to immutable snapshots and source-position basis; preserve replay gaps and cancellation scope.
positive_cases: Independent headless clients inspect the same snapshot with matching result identities.
negative_cases: Stale cursor, mixed filters or wrong context/epoch refuses.
Cancelling inspection cannot claim the underlying build was cancelled.

tasks.title: Deliver the standalone interactive boot inspector
tasks.goal: Make tree/detail/source/compare usable on the shared debugger model.
steps: Reuse existing standalone viewer components or a thin local viewer over the shared model.
Implement graph navigation, source/why-included details and two-snapshot comparison with diagnostics.
Keep viewport/selection in presentation state; domain queries use typed services and preserve canonical boot output.
positive_cases: Selecting a package/fragment shows accurate source and inclusion details.
Compare exposes changes between exact snapshots.
negative_cases: A large/partial graph remains navigable with explicit missing data.
UI actions cannot bypass service authority or turn text labels into semantic IDs.
